prompt:
Implement a 4-to-2 priority encoder with valid flag.
Module header:
module prienc4(input [3:0] in, output reg [1:0] out, output reg valid);
Highest set bit wins (bit 3 highest). valid is 1 when any input bit is set, else 0 and out is 0. Reply with complete Verilog.
